serialisation.name: CSEF serialisation of SG-MDF
serialisation.note: DIN SPEC 91380:2018-06 defines SG-MDF as a grammar with no official JSON or XML schema. Element names and nesting follow the DIN SPEC. This file is not published or endorsed by DIN.

gameInfo.abstract: Maths puzzle game played in class, teacher-managed.
gameInfo.playTime: 15 to 20 minutes per lesson; 12 lessons in the full garden

useInfo.dataRecordingTransfer: Personal data recorded: yes, user accounts. Processed by third parties: Hosting provider (hosting and database, DE). Provider's GDPR role: processor (the school or family decides what happens to the data). Retention: gameplay events for end of school year + 30 days. Privacy notice: https://example.org/garden-of-numbers/privacy. Declared in csef.yaml; checked with CSEF 0.13.0.

educational.teachingConcept: Guided discovery with worked examples, then practice
educational.curriculum: Portuguese Aprendizagens Essenciais, Mathematics, years 3 and 4 (fractions)

distributionInfo.priceInfo: Yearly school licence per class. No purchases inside the product; licences are bought by adults (school or family).

platformInfo.requirementInfo: Current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a tablet or laptop; no installation
